preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of numbers Nastia has and the length of the array a are both between 1 and 10^5.
Each element in the array a is between 0 and the total number of numbers Nastia has.
The sum of all elements in the array a equals the total number of numbers Nastia has.

preconditions.expression: The sum of m and k across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The combined sum of the number of numbers and the length of the array a across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: The size of the matrix n is at least 2.

postconditions.expression: n * n matrix contains all numbers from 1 to k
postconditions.description: The matrix must include all numbers from 1 to k exactly as specified in the input array a.

postconditions.expression: For each 2x2 submatrix, the number of occupied cells does not exceed 3
postconditions.description: Each 2x2 submatrix in the matrix must have at most 3 filled cells.

postconditions.expression: The numbers on each diagonal are distinct
postconditions.description: For each 2x2 submatrix, the numbers on the diagonals must be different.
The output matrix should be the smallest possible n x n matrix that satisfies the above conditions.

invariants.expression: The matrix is filled with numbers from 1 to k
invariants.description: The matrix must be filled with the numbers specified in the input array a.

invariants.expression: The matrix is the smallest possible size to satisfy the conditions
invariants.description: The matrix should be the smallest n x n matrix that can contain all the numbers from 1 to k and satisfy the 2x2 submatrix conditions.
